# grove clone: no directory defaults to cwd/repo-name

mkdir sources

mkdir sources/dotted.git
exec git init sources/dotted.git
cd sources/dotted.git
cp $WORK/README.md .
exec git add .
exec git commit -m 'initial commit'
cd $WORK

mkdir sources/plain
exec git init sources/plain
cd sources/plain
cp $WORK/README.md .
exec git add .
exec git commit -m 'initial commit'
cd $WORK

mkdir clones
cd clones
exec grove clone $WORK/sources/dotted.git --branches main
exists dotted/.bare
exists dotted/main/README.md
exec grove clone $WORK/sources/plain --branches main
exists plain/.bare
exists plain/main/README.md

-- README.md --
# Test Repository
